history.summary: A very large 1,756 sqft 99-year 3BR at Belysa (an EC, 2014) in D18 Pasir Ris at $2.05M ($1,167 PSF). The low PSF is a function of an oversized unit, and the $2.05M total pushes past the deep-liquidity band for an OCR ex-EC that's 1.1km from MRT.
history.rating_rationale: Belysa is a former Executive Condo (now privatised), so the $1,167 PSF looks cheap mainly because the unit is unusually large (1,756 sqft) — total quantum of $2.05M is high for OCR Pasir Ris and exceeds the deepest-demand band. Elias MRT (CP2, Cross Island Line) is 1.1km (13-min walk) away. No URA data; arena record is sub-.500 (256-302). The CRL is a genuine regional catalyst, but the big quantum and ex-EC ceiling on appreciation keep this a balanced Neutral.
red_flags: Oversized 1,756 sqft unit makes the low PSF misleading; $2.05M quantum is high for OCR
Former EC — appreciation tends to plateau after privatisation premium is captured
No URA appreciation/txn data; sub-.500 arena record
catalysts: Cross Island Line (Elias/Pasir Ris) ~2030 regional connectivity uplift
Large family layout suits Pasir Ris owner-occupier/upgrader demand
99-yr EC stock priced below private condos

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Pasir Ris rental demand is family/HDB-upgrader oriented and modest; a large 3BR at $2.05M yields poorly (~3% or below) and competes with cheaper nearby stock.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Ex-ECs appreciate steadily but with a ceiling once the HDB-to-private gap closes; CRL is the main upside lever. Without project data, expect OCR-average growth.
